title: Quantiles, Not Points: Streaming Quantile Matching for Ordinal-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.00447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge scores are often distributionally shifted from human ratings on any given evaluation task, and post-hoc calibration (mapping LLM to human scores in a small labeled anchor set) has become a popular method to correct for this shift. In this paper we derive the calibration from two positions: that LLMaJ scores are ordinal ratings drawn from a distribution rather than isolated points. We present streaming quantile matching (SQM), a version of a classical method not previously bench marked for LLMaJ calibration, which is built on the two positions by computing the optimal-transport map between the LLM and human score distributions. We develop an evaluation framework and within it we show that unlike point-wise calibrations, SQM respects the ordinality of the human anchor set and achieves the best distributional fidelity and the top overall rank across models and data. translated_title: 分位数而非点：用于序数感知的LLM-as-a-Judge校准的流式分位数匹配
translated_abstract: 在任何给定的评估任务中，LLM-as-a-judge的评分往往与人类评分存在分布偏移，而事后校准（即在小型带标签的锚点集上将LLM评分映射为人类评分）已成为纠正这种偏移的流行方法。在本文中，我们从两个立场出发来推导校准方法：LLaJ评分是从分布中抽取的序数评级，而非孤立的点。我们提出了流式分位数匹配（SQM），这是对一种经典方法的新应用，此前尚未在LLaJ校准中进行过基准测试，该方法通过计算LLM评分分布与人类评分分布之间的最优传输映射来建立在上述两个立场之上。我们开发了一个评估框架，并在其中证明：与逐点校准不同，SQM尊重人类锚点集的序数性，并在各模型和数据上实现了最佳的分布保真度和总体最高排名。我们还表明，总体而言，事后校准缩小了
tldr: 提出流式分位数匹配（SQM）校准方法，通过最优传输将LLM评分分布映射到人类评分分布，尊重评分的序数性并实现了最佳的分布保真度。
en_tdlr: Proposes Streaming Quantile Matching (SQM), an ordinal-aware post-hoc calibration method that uses optimal transport to map LLM-as-a-judge score distributions to human rating distributions, achieving the best distributional fidelity and top overall rank across models and datasets.
